About Obscura

Obscura V is a camera app packed full of features to help you take incredible photos. Obscura pairs a stunning design with intuitive controls that make taking photos a delight.

—

Over its 10+ years on the App Store, Obscura has been featured numerous times around the world, including as Editors’ Choice and App of the Day.

—

Design

Obscura squeezes a bunch of powerful features into simple controls anyone can master. The interface balances aesthetics, ergonomics, and intuitiveness. You won’t want to use anything else. Controls can be reached with one thumb, and gestures and haptics combine to create a tactile experience that lets you stay focused on your subject.

—

Capture Modes & Formats

Obscura captures photos, videos, Live Photos, and portraits. Photos can be captured in RAW, ProRAW, HEIC, and JPEG (on supported devices, see http://obscura.camera/compatibility).

Capture images in multiple different aspect ratios, or apply filters live in camera for a wide variety of styles.

—

Camera Settings

Obscura gives you control over exposure, focus, white balance, ISO, shutter speed, and flash, with intuitive controls that make you feel in control of your device’s camera.

—

Live Filters

Obscura includes a bunch of great filters to give your photos instant style but you can also create your own and use them live in-camera. It’s very cool and very powerful.

—

View Options

Obscura lets you display a grid, a spirit level, a histogram, focus peaking, a focus loupe, and exposure clipping highlights to help you understand every detail of what you’re shooting.

—

Photo Library

Obscura has its own interface for browsing, rating, editing, and sharing images, but it’s fully integrated with your system photo library, so images captured with Obscura are available everywhere.

—

Obscura Ultra

Obscura is free to use, with an annual subscription for premium features. See http://obscura.camera/ultra for full details.

—

I hope you love using Obscura as much as I’ve loved designing and building it. If you do, please consider subscribing to Ultra, leaving a review, or just sharing with a friend.

All the best,

Ben

About Carbon

The macro tracker that coaches you.

Carbon Diet Coach is a nutrition coach and calorie tracker in one. Log your food, weigh in, and check in once a week. Carbon reviews your weight trend and what you logged, decides whether your targets should change, and explains every decision.

Carbon pioneered adaptive macro coaching, and thousands of members use it to lose fat, build muscle, maintain, and reverse diet.

HOW WEEKLY COACHING WORKS

• Answer a few questions about your goal, body, and preferences

• Get personalized calorie, protein, carb, and fat targets

• Log your food and weigh in, or sync your weight from Apple Health

• Check in weekly. Carbon looks at your multi-week weight trend and what you actually logged, then adjusts your macros or holds them steady

• Read a clear check-in report, so you're never left wondering why Carbon did or didn't make a change

• Pick your check-in day, or check in early when your schedule changes

PROTEIN BUILT AROUND YOU

Your protein target is based on your lean body mass, with an optimal range for your goal and diet style. Research links higher protein intake during fat loss to keeping more lean mass, so Carbon keeps protein front and center all week.

About ADHD White Noise

White Noise for Staying On Task

For adults with ADHD, distractions can make staying on task a more significant challenge than usual.

If you have trouble shutting out the world when you need to study, write, paint, spark creativity, sleep, or get down to business at work, this free service is perfect for your needs.

Often someone who has ADHD can think better and stay on task longer if there is some white noise in her surroundings—maybe softly playing music, a fan in the corner, or the hum from an overhead air vent. So far, researchers have found benefits for those with inattention but not impulsivity, but the benefits of white noise don’t continue when it is no longer present. In the real world, people cannot control the sounds that surround them throughout the day. Although researchers are exploring whether white noise may provide complementary support for some people with inattentive ADHD, the evidence is inconclusive.

Research on white noise for inattentive ADHD

Most research on white noise has focused on children still in elementary or middle school; however, the results seem to be applicable also to teens and adults. For adults working from home at this time, having white noise available could be beneficial when it comes to staying on task.

About Incognito

Incognito is a private web browser you can pull up anywhere. From any app: long-press a link or select text, tap Share, and then choose the Incognito action extension. Boom: instant web browser!

Need to lock people out of your web history or bookmarks? Incognito can do that too!

Incognito is great for:

• Viewing a web page inside the current app without jumping to Safari.

• Opening sketchy links without risking your privacy.

• Reopening a web page with cookies disabled — and yes, that means Incognito lets you dodge most paywalls.

• Searching Google from anywhere — just select the text you want to search, choose “Share” from the popup menu, and then choose the “Search in Incognito” action.

• Searching with something besides Google: use Kagi, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Brave, Qwant, Yahoo, or whatever search engine you prefer.

• Keeping your web history and bookmarks private and passcode-locked. Or you can disable browsing history and leave no trace!

Incognito is also a Swiss Army Knife of web tools:

• Open a page in another browser such as Safari, Chrome, Firefox, Opera, Brave, or DuckDuckGo.

• Remove AMP so you can browse or share the original URL. 

• Translate the page using Google Translate (beta).

• Open a web page with the archive.today service (Incognito is not affiliated with archive.today or archive.is).

• Save a PDF of an entire web page.

• Set Incognito as your default browser.

• Clear your session history.

Incognito is all about privacy:

• All web browsing is in “private mode” by default, so all cookies and web data are discarded after each session.

• Incognito has no ads, no third-party trackers, and does not send or re-route your web searches anywhere.

• If you require extra privacy, Incognito has options to disable browsing history and/or exclude it from your iCloud Backups.

Incognito is paid upfront with a small, one-time fee. There are no subscriptions, in-app purchases, ads, or deals with sketchy "search engines" like many of the "free" so-called private browser apps. You can trust me with your privacy because you know how I got paid: once, by you, that's it.

Incognito was created by an independent developer living in California.

apps.localizedDescription:
Turmoil+ offers players a visually charming, tongue-in-cheek take on the simulation genre inspired by the 19th century oil rush in North America. Get a taste of the rush and rivalry of the time as you earn your way to become a successful oil entrepreneur. As you make money digging up and selling oil, the town will grow along with you.

Lease land at the town auction and search for oil. Build a rig, create an efficient pipe network and bring up the oil to store it in silos. Sell the oil at the best times to maximize profits. Then buy essential upgrades in town to cope with rock, gas and ice. Acquire more town shares than your competitors in a bid to become the new mayor.





- A campaign where you build your rags-to-riches oil baron career and beat your rivals.

- Dozens of upgrades and new tools to improve your oil mining operations.

- Maximize your profits by using natural gas to boost the oil price.

- Outbid your competitors at the stock auction.

- Meet the town’s characters in the saloon and make shady business deals.

- Play single game mode to get one of literally millions of procedurally generated levels and earn as much as you can in one year.





Turmoil+ - The Heat Is On is a new campaign with tons of oil to dig up and convert into cash! It is designed to make you feel right at home, but at the same time offer lots of new mechanics and fun features. Here's what you can expect!

- A new town (and mayor!) and a new oil-rich map divided into three areas.

- In each area, new drilling mechanics are introduced, powered by a new underground substance: magma.

- You'll see familiar faces like Edward and Fred and William. They brought their goods with them in train wagons, so you can instantly stock up on all your favorite drilling gear.

- There are also new people, like Philip, who runs a shady card game in the saloon.

- Jack is a new character that runs a magma tools operation from his shed. He likes chicken.

- Anthony is also back from last time. Instead of dealing in diamonds, he has his own store where you can sell and buy all sorts of underground treasures.

- The new mayor is not quite like the old one. His tips are free, and he uses a different auction system. But shares still cost money!

- There's a cat walking around the village! He doesn't do a whole lot, but what can you expect from these creatures?

- And last but not least: a couple of brand new music tracks!



The metagame in this new DLC-campaign offers more depth. Instead of diamonds, a total of 9 underground treasures are available. Collecting them all (by trading or digging them up) will offer great benefits. Besides this, the village offers even more things to do, like playing a card game for money.

apps.name: UTM SE
apps.localizedDescription:
UTM is a full featured virtual machine host for iOS. In short, it allows you to run Windows, Android, and more on your iPhone and iPad.
This version runs on all iOS 14+ devices but lacks JIT support and is slower than regular UTM.


More information at https://getutm.app/

Features:

• Emulate any Processor
30+ processors supported by qemu including x86_64, ARM64, and RISC-V
• Run any Operating System
Windows, Linux, and more natively and securely on iOS within an App
• Fast Emulation
Para-virtualization with SPICE and JIT compilation with TCG
• High Compatibility
iOS 14+ supported. Works on iPhone and iPad. No jailbreak needed
• Free and Open Source
UTM and its dependencies are all free and open source
• Easy to Use
Configure and customize your VM in a native UI

versions.localizedDescription:
## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (macOS) **Smoother displays**: VMs now follow your display's refresh rate, so motion is fluid at up to 120 Hz on ProMotion displays.
* **More reliable USB**: Fast external SSDs can now be shared with a VM, and disconnecting a drive no longer freezes UTM. On macOS, drives are safely unmounted before they are handed to a VM.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* (macOS) Check out [UTM Games Database](https://db.getutm.app/) to see and report game compatibility for the experimental 3D driver. Re-install the Windows guest tools to get the latest driver.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.
* SCSI drives on ARM64 virtual machines now use a VirtIO SCSI controller. A VM with a SCSI drive that was suspended, or has a snapshot with saved state, from an earlier version cannot resume it: delete the saved state and start the VM again.

## Changes (v5.0.9)
* (macOS 14) Display: Reverted the fix for VM windows being limited to 60 fps on ProMotion displays, because it could crash a VM at startup (#8204) and blurred Retina mode (#8191). VM windows still run at 120 Hz on a ProMotion display, unless a slower external display is the main display (added 2026-11-18)
* Fixed Windows games hanging at startup while compiling shaders, in-game videos stalling after the first frame, and a failed 3D command resetting the guest's display (#7984)
* Fixed X11 apps under Xwayland not displaying with Vulkan on Linux
* Updated the virglrenderer, MoltenVK and DXMT graphics backends
* Security: Fixed memory corruption issues that could allow a malicious guest to gain sandboxed code execution in the isolated rendering process (thanks Xusheng Li at Vector 35 Inc)
* Home: VM notes now render Markdown (#3547) (thanks @pingu-the-penguin)
* Home: Fixed the confirmation for Clone, Stop or Move not appearing the second time it was requested for the same VM (thanks @ianplusplus)
* Home: Fixed the screenshot in the VM details being covered by a flat color on iOS 26, macOS 26 and visionOS 26
* Home: The size shown in the VM details now updates after the settings are closed (#7923)
* Home: A VM on an external drive that is listed as unavailable now stays available after its .utm is opened again (#7762)
* Home: Fixed one unreadable saved entry making every VM lose its saved location, window state and external drives
* Config: SCSI drives on ARM64 virtual machines now use a VirtIO SCSI controller, so guests without an LSI driver such as Rocky Linux and RHEL can see them (#7712)
* Config: Fixed PowerPC VMs created with the default settings failing to start because of too many CPU cores
* Config: Fixed the default devices of the Heathrow PowerMac (g3beige) machine keeping the VM from starting (#7803)
* Config: Fixed the default configuration of the Sam460ex machine failing to start (#7603)
* Config: Fixed new PowerPC VMs such as pseries defaulting to a network card that the machine rejects (#7592)
* Config: Fixed saving a VM failing after adding a TPM on RISC-V and LoongArch
* Config: Fixed a crash opening the terminal window of a VM whose configuration has no terminal settings
* Config: Fixed the host port of port forwards being replaced by the guest port when migrating a UTM 3 configuration
* QEMU: Guests with a VirtIO GPU now use the host display's refresh rate instead of always 75 Hz (#7820) (thanks @dragoshont)
* QEMU: Fixed saving a VM state that takes longer than 10 seconds being reported as "Timed out waiting for RPC" (#8052)
* QEMU: Fixed networking and the guest agent stalling once QEMU holds about a thousand open files, such as with a busy shared directory or 3D acceleration (#7624)
* QEMU: Fixed the display modes missing from the Monitors control panel of Mac OS guests on the mac99 machine (thanks @giovariot)
* QEMU: Fixed sound in Mac OS 9 and a hang at startup in its sound driver (#8033)
* QEMU: Fixed Mac OS 9 restarting to a black screen (#7999)
* QEMU: Fixed sound crackling and dropping out while the host is busy
* QEMU: Fixed Windows showing "Display output is not active." for several seconds on every boot with GPU acceleration
* QEMU: Fixed wrong colors in Windows programs that run in exclusive fullscreen with a 10-bit display format
* QEMU: Fixed a newly created VM not writing its debug log until UTM was restarted
* SPICE: Fixed sound staying silent until UTM was restarted after the guest stopped playing audio (#8148)
* CocoaSpice: Fixed a VM restored from a saved state showing a black screen until the guest draws again (#8050)
* CocoaSpice: Fixed a crash when a VM's screenshot was redrawn after the guest changed resolution or the VM stopped (#7745)
* Guest Agent: Fixed a guest being able to crash UTM through the guest agent port (#7684)
* USB: Fixed sharing 10 Gbps (USB 3.2 Gen 2) devices such as external SSDs and NVMe enclosures (#7530) (thanks @giovariot)
* USB: Fixed UTM freezing when a USB 3 drive is disconnected from a running VM (#5851)
* USB: Fixed USB audio devices playing slowly and stuttering (#8028) (thanks @gitwillsky)
* Downloader: Fixed the guest tools never updating after the first download when UTM runs in a language other than English (#7978)
* Downloader: VMs downloaded from a link now show the same warning about custom QEMU arguments as imported VMs (#7733)
* Downloader: Fixed some ZIP files importing as an empty VM
* Shortcuts: Fixed "Pause Virtual Machine" with Save State not saving the state
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS 15) Fixed a crash on launch
* (iOS) Fixed the state saved by "Auto save on background" being lost when iOS ends UTM (#8051)
* (iOS) Home: Fixed a crash when selecting a VM whose configuration failed to load
* (iOS) Home: Fixed the settings closing right away when editing a VM while the list is in edit mode (#7939)
* (iOS SE) QEMU: Fixed wrong results from vector comparisons in guests (#7722)
* (macOS) Fixed a VM never starting, and blocking every later start, when it is started while UTM is hidden (#4091, #7988)
* (macOS) Fixed D3DMetal being selected on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 27 without Rosetta (#8002) (thanks @pingu-the-penguin)

* (macOS 12) Fixed the Virtual Machine menu having no title in the menu bar (#8117)
* (macOS 14) ~~Display: Fixed VM windows being limited to 60 fps on ProMotion displays when connected to an external display (thanks @dragoshont)~~

* (macOS) Display: Fixed clicks from automation, accessibility tools and touch displays landing at the previous pointer position
* (macOS) Toolbar: The USB, drives, shared folder, windows and keyboard shortcut menus now open under their button instead of at the pointer

* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed GPU-accelerated VMs crashing at startup on Intel Macs (#8036)
* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed multi-core VMs hanging after the guest reboots (#8009)

* (macOS) SPICE: Fixed a crash while sharing the clipboard with the guest (#8106)
* (macOS) USB: A drive's volumes are now unmounted before it is connected to a VM, which avoids the "Disk Not Ejected Properly" warning (#5650) (thanks @giovariot)

* (macOS) Scripting: More QEMU options and the sound devices can be set in the configuration, and `guest size` now grows an existing drive
* (macOS) Scripting: The input commands and `capture screen` now work with Apple VMs, and a macOS VM can be created and installed without supplying an IPSW

## Installation

* [iOS](https://docs.getutm.app/installation/ios/)
* [macOS](https://docs.getutm.app/installation/macos/)

| File | Description | Installation | JIT | Hypervisor | USB |
|------|------------|--------------|-----|-----------|-----|
| UTM.deb | Jailbroken iOS version | Open in Cydia, dpkg, or Sileo | Yes | Yes(1) | Yes |
| UTM.dmg | macOS version | Mounting and copying UTM.app to /Applications | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| UTM.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (sideloading) | AltStore, etc (see guide) | Yes(2) | No | No |
| UTM-HV.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (TrollStore) | TrollStore | Yes | Yes(1) | Yes |
| UTM-SE.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (sideloading) | AltStore, enterprise signing, etc | No | No | No |
| UTM-Remote.ipa | Remote client | Any | No | No | No |

1. Hypervisor on iOS requires an M1 iPad or newer.
2. Enabling JIT may require a separate JIT enabler such as [Jitterbug][2] or Jitstreamer.

### Verification (macOS)

The macOS release (`UTM.dmg`) is notarized by Apple. To verify the download, run `xcrun stapler validate UTM.dmg`. To verify the install, run `spctl -a -vv /Applications/UTM.app` and check that it is notarized and signed by `Turing Software, LLC (WDNLXAD4W8)`. This needs a network connection, so it cannot run from a sandbox that blocks outgoing connections.

[1]: https://getutm.app/install/
[2]: https://github.com/osy/Jitterbug

The world is at your fingertips as you fight for survival, explore for fortune, and dig for glory. Delve deep into cavernous expanses, test your mettle in combat, or construct your own city!

Presenting an impressive catalogue of 5,000+ items, 25+ NPCs, and 400+ enemies and blending elements of classic action games with sandbox-style creativity, Terraria is truly a unique adventure!



The latest content update includes:



NEW 1.4.5 CONTENT:

- Dead Cells crossover content – new weapons, combat accessories and more!

- Iconic Pals from Palworld have arrived in Terraria!

- Fifteen new furniture sets.

- Five new types of boulders — watch your step!

- Four new transformation mounts.

- New whips and Summoner prefixes.

- New Kites, critters, and decorative features.

- And so much more to discover!





NEW WORLD SEEDS TO DISCOVER:

- A new Skyblock world seed.

- A new world creation menu allowing you to mix and match special seeds.

- Improvements to existing seeds!



IMPROVEMENTS:

- Reworks and balance improvements to weapons.

- Visual updates to many classic sprites.

- And so many more improvements!



• MULTIPLAYER – Play with up to 7 friends on Local Wifi or Online via device-device Wifi hosted games or through the Mobile Terraria Dedicated Server for PC (available for free on Terraria.org)

• TERRARIA REIMAGINED FOR MOBILE – Fully customizable controls and User Interface provide a level of polish and capability not previously possible!

• Gamepad support – including fully-remappable buttons - Play with your Bluetooth connected gamepad where supported.

apps.subtitle: Move to the countryside, and cultivate a new life in this award-winning open-ended farming RPG! With over 50+
apps.localizedDescription:
Move to the countryside, and cultivate a new life in this award-winning open-ended farming RPG! With over 50+ hours of gameplay content and new Mobile-specific features, such as auto-save and multiple controls options.

**Winner of the Golden Joysticks' Breakthrough Award**

**Nominee of Game of the Year 2017 - BAFTA Games Awards**



---



BUILD THE FARM OF YOUR DREAMS:



■ Turn your overgrown fields into a lively and bountiful farm



■ Raise and breed happy animals, grow a variety of seasonal crops and design your farm, your way



■ Customize your farmer and home! With hundreds of options to choose from



■ Settle down and start a family with 12 potential marriage candidates



■ Become part of the community by taking part in seasonal festivals and villager quests



■ Explore vast, mysterious caves, encountering dangerous monsters and valuable treasure



■ Spend a relaxing afternoon at one of the local fishing spots or go crabbing by the seaside



■ Forage, grow crops and produce artisan goods to cook up as a delicious meal



■ Rebuilt for touch-screen gameplay on iOS with mobile-specific features, such as auto-select to toggle quickly between your farming tools and auto-attack to swiftly take down fiendish monsters in the mines



■ Continue farming from where you last left off with auto-save (even if you close the app!)



■ Play the game your way with multiple controls options, such as touch-screen and virtual joystick



■ Newly Updated Single Player Content - Including new town upgrades, dating events, crops, fishing ponds, hats, clothing, and new pets! Plus more to be discovered...



---



“The best version of Stardew Valley is the one you have with you … This game is absolutely incredible, and will not disappoint.” - TouchArcade



"Stardew Valley beautifully combines farm simulation with RPG elements to create an intriguing, absorbing rural world." - IGN



“Far more than just a farming game... filled with seemingly endless content and heart.” Giant Bomb



"Village life has never been so accessible and satisfying" - The Telegraph



“Stardew Valley has been the most rich and heartwarming experience I’ve had in a game in years.” CG Magazine



---



Note: Features new 1.6 update story content, multiplayer functionality not supported. No in-app purchases.



*All accolades belong to the App Store version of Stardew Valley, except for the following, which belong to the original title: Golden Joysticks' Breakthrough Award, BAFTA Games Award nomination, and comments by Giant Bomb and the Telegraph.

apps.subtitle: free paid app ----- Alpin Quest PRO is a professional GPS and field GIS application developed for military per
apps.localizedDescription:
free paid app ----- Alpin Quest PRO is a professional GPS and field GIS application developed for military personnel, geologists, surveyors, foresters, mountaineers, hunters, and off-road drivers. Import paper maps to your device and track your precise location offline in the field.

MAPS

• Satellite, topographic, hybrid, and street maps; contour lines and shaded relief

• Named peaks, mountain passes, water sources, and rivers

• MGRS and UTM kilometer grids; scale lock capability (e.g., 1:25,000)

• Real-time terrain type, slope, and elevation data



IMPORT CUSTOM MAPS

• GeoPDF (ArcGIS, QGIS, stand maps), GeoTIFF, MBTiles, GeoPackage

• KMZ overlay layers and multi-level large KMZ archives

• Shapefile (ZIP), KML/KMZ vector files, Memory-Map (.qct), AlpineQuest AQX

• Image with world file: PNG, JPG, TIFF with PGW, JGW, TFW

• Collar clipping (hide white borders), transparency adjustment, and layer ordering



OFFLINE FUNCTIONALITY

• Download current screen view, selected map areas, or route corridors

• Automatic caching of visited locations

• Full functionality without cellular network coverage



COORDINATE SYSTEMS (19)

• MGRS, UTM, USNG, WGS84, DMS, DDM, Plus Code, QTH

• ED50, CK-42 / SK-42, BNG (OSGB), India Grid, NSF LCC, Lambert Maroc

• Gauss-Krüger Argentina, Arc 1960, RSO Malaya, SAD69

• Simultaneous coordinate display across all systems with one-tap copy

• Magnetic declination (NOAA WMM), true, magnetic, and grid north; degrees or mils



WAYPOINTS & TARGETS

• Unlimited waypoints, photo attachments, categories, and quick search

• Manual coordinate entry and waypoint averaging for maximum accuracy

• Live distance, bearing, and estimated time of arrival (ETA)

• Customizable label positions: top, bottom, left, right



ROUTES & TRACK RECORDING

• Point-to-point, freehand drawing, or finger-traced route creation

• Auto-routing optimized for walking, driving, and hiking

• Elevation profiles with real-time ascent and descent metrics

• Continuous background track recording with speed and distance statistics

• Off-route proximity alerts



3D TERRAIN

• Review routes and tactical areas overlaid on real 3D terrain elevation



AREAS & DRAWING

• Polygons, circles, and rectangles; precise area and perimeter calculations

• Map-based reshaping, vertex editing, and splitting

• Geology rock hatch patterns; freehand sketch and text annotations for briefings



PROJECTS (GIS) & TEAM MODE

• Consolidate waypoints, routes, areas, and custom maps into unified projects

• Export to KML, KMZ, GPX, Shapefile, and UTM Shapefile

• Team Mode: Share project data with team members and track team positions live



AR & WATCH INTEGRATION

• Augmented Reality (AR) camera view identifying surrounding peaks and passes

• Apple Watch bearing guidance and compass navigation



FIELD TOOLS

• Proximity alarm: alerts when approaching target points

• Photo coordinate and direction stamping

• Weather forecasts: hourly and 7-day outlook, sun/moon phases and rise/set times

• Battery-optimized tracking profiles

• Volume button zoom control for gloved use

• Gridded PDF map export (A4, A3)

• Interactive walkthrough tutorial



FILE SHARING

• Import: GPX, KML, KMZ, GeoJSON, DXF, Shapefile

• Export: GPX, KML, KMZ, CSV, Shapefile, GeoPDF, GeoPackage

• Direct opening from WhatsApp, Mail, and the Files app

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This lets you include audio with your videos and search using your voice.

versions.localizedDescription:
YouTube Plus v6.0

YouTube Plus Player
- New built-in player for downloaded videos and for streaming videos straight from YouTube without downloading
- Queue, video quality selection, subtitles, audio tracks, ambient mode, SponsorBlock, sleep timer, Discord RPC, gestures, mini player, background playback, Picture-in-Picture and more
- Remembers playback progress and resumes where you left off
- Option to open videos in the YouTube Plus player instead of YouTube's

Downloads
- New Downloads tab with shared, separate and private sections
- Select multiple files and act on them at once
- Resume interrupted downloads
- Download whole playlists
- Download later action in the download menu
- Edit metadata before and after downloading
- Convert videos and songs before downloading or any time later
- Downloads keep running in the background
- Download sheet remembers the last selected post-download action and encoding preset
- Improved downloader engine with support for new YouTube versions

Parental control
- Passcode for YouTube and YouTube Plus settings, account switching and the tab bar menu
- Restricted mode
- External link blocking
- Watch history
- Daily limit and allowed hours
- Channel blocklist and allowlist

YouTube Player
- Improved speed controls in the player overlay
- Inverted fullscreen option in the player overlay
- Loop button in the player overlay
- Rearrange the tweak's buttons in the player overlay
- Option to disable Picture-in-Picture
- Added "Don't offer SharePlay" option
- Option to keep feed videos muted when pressing the volume buttons
- Sleep timer can stop playback after a chosen chapter
- Improved selection of quality, subtitles and audio tracks
- Set several preferred languages for audio tracks and subtitles
- Option to enable captions when the preferred audio track isn't available
- More options to hide buttons under the player and in the context menu
- Improved playback fix mechanism
- Fixed YouTube Premium downloads on sideloaded installs (requires a YouTube Premium subscription)

Feed & Shorts
- Hide sponsored videos in profiles, new Playables and other feed elements (see the Feed section)
- Hide the new ads in Shorts
- Improved hiding of unwanted elements
- Fixed Shorts auto-skip on newer versions

Tab bar
- Add playlists as tabs
- Improved tab editor, tabs can now be edited offline
- The Downloads tab no longer reappears on every launch

SponsorBlock
- Submit segments, vote on existing ones and change their categories
- View all sponsor segments from the SponsorBlock menu in the player overlay

Interface & Settings
- Liquid Glass support (enable in Interface settings)
- The keyboard always stays original regardless of the selected interface, except for the floating keyboard
- Removed the OLED keyboard on iOS 27 (no longer works on sideload)
- Fixed sheets not following the YouTube theme
- More options to hide navigation bar buttons
- All menus redesigned, improved search bar and Split View support on iPad
- License status and date in the tweak's settings
- Fixed random "Access denied" errors

Other
- Adapted for YouTube 21.43 and iPhone Duo: floating tab bar, new channel watermarks, OLED theme in the new feed
- Fixed playback issues
- Improved support for legacy versions
- Improved opening of videos from links

versions.localizedDescription:
YouTube Plus v6.0

YouTube Plus Player
- New built-in player for downloaded videos and for streaming videos straight from YouTube without downloading
- Queue, video quality selection, subtitles, audio tracks, ambient mode, SponsorBlock, sleep timer, Discord RPC, gestures, mini player, background playback, Picture-in-Picture and more
- Remembers playback progress and resumes where you left off
- Option to open videos in the YouTube Plus player instead of YouTube's

Downloads
- New Downloads tab with shared, separate and private sections
- Select multiple files and act on them at once
- Resume interrupted downloads
- Download whole playlists
- Download later action in the download menu
- Edit metadata before and after downloading
- Convert videos and songs before downloading or any time later
- Downloads keep running in the background
- Download sheet remembers the last selected post-download action and encoding preset
- Improved downloader engine with support for new YouTube versions

Parental control
- Passcode for YouTube and YouTube Plus settings, account switching and the tab bar menu
- Restricted mode
- External link blocking
- Watch history
- Daily limit and allowed hours
- Channel blocklist and allowlist

YouTube Player
- Improved speed controls in the player overlay
- Inverted fullscreen option in the player overlay
- Loop button in the player overlay
- Rearrange the tweak's buttons in the player overlay
- Option to disable Picture-in-Picture
- Added "Don't offer SharePlay" option
- Option to keep feed videos muted when pressing the volume buttons
- Sleep timer can stop playback after a chosen chapter
- Improved selection of quality, subtitles and audio tracks
- Set several preferred languages for audio tracks and subtitles
- Option to enable captions when the preferred audio track isn't available
- More options to hide buttons under the player and in the context menu
- Improved playback fix mechanism
- Fixed YouTube Premium downloads on sideloaded installs (requires a YouTube Premium subscription)

Feed & Shorts
- Hide sponsored videos in profiles, new Playables and other feed elements (see the Feed section)
- Hide the new ads in Shorts
- Improved hiding of unwanted elements
- Fixed Shorts auto-skip on newer versions

Tab bar
- Add playlists as tabs
- Improved tab editor, tabs can now be edited offline
- The Downloads tab no longer reappears on every launch

SponsorBlock
- Submit segments, vote on existing ones and change their categories
- View all sponsor segments from the SponsorBlock menu in the player overlay

Interface & Settings
- Liquid Glass support (enable in Interface settings)
- The keyboard always stays original regardless of the selected interface, except for the floating keyboard
- Removed the OLED keyboard on iOS 27 (no longer works on sideload)
- Fixed sheets not following the YouTube theme
- More options to hide navigation bar buttons
- All menus redesigned, improved search bar and Split View support on iPad
- License status and date in the tweak's settings
- Fixed random "Access denied" errors

Other
- Adapted for YouTube 21.43 and iPhone Duo: floating tab bar, new channel watermarks, OLED theme in the new feed
- Fixed playback issues
- Improved support for legacy versions
- Improved opening of videos from links

apps.name: CapCut++
apps.subtitle: Video editor
apps.localizedDescription:
CapCut offers easy-to-use video editing functions, in-APP fonts and effects, advanced features such as keyframe animation, smooth slow-motion, chroma key, and stabilization, to help you capture and snip moments.

Create fancy videos with other unique features: auto captions, text-to-speech, motion tracking, and background removal. Show your personality and go viral on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Facebook!

FEATURES
Basic video editing
• Trim and shorten clips and split or merge videos.
• Adjust video speed from 0.1x to 100x, and apply speed curves to clips.
• Animate video clips with incredible zoom in/out effects.
• Highlight the best moments with the freeze feature.
• Explore transition options with awesome effects on and between clips.

Advanced video editor
• Keyframe video animation is available for all settings.
• Edit videos to create smooth slow-motion with the optical flow feature and speed curve tool.
• Use the chroma key to remove specific colors from videos.
• Easy to arrange and preview clips on multi-track timeline.
• The stabilizing feature keeps video footage steady.

Intelligent features
• Auto captions: automate speech recognition and subtitles in videos.
• Text-to-speech: apply text-to-speech in multiple languages and voices.
• Background removal: automatically remove backgrounds.

Text & Stickers
• Add text to videos with different fonts and styles, choose unique text templates. Fonts can be imported locally.
• Subtitles can be added to the timeline of video tracks and can be moved and adjusted in one step.

Trending Effects & Filters
• Match video content with diverse filters that are updated weekly with the latest trends.
• Edit videos with hundreds of trending effects, including Glitch, Blur, 3D, etc.
• Add movie-style video filters or adjust video brightness, contrast, etc.

Music & Sound Effects
• Add millions of music clips and sound effects to videos.
• Extract audio, clips, and recordings from videos.

Easy to Share
• Custom video export resolution, HD video editor supports 4K 60fps exports and smart HDR.
• Adjust the format and share with your friends on social media platforms.

CapCut is an all-in-one video editor and video maker application with everything you need to create stunning, high-quality videos. Beginners can get started with CapCut in a matter of seconds, while advanced users can enjoy all the functions they need to edit videos.

versions.localizedDescription:
iPhone Duo
• Delta unfolds in all new ways to take full advantage of iPhone Duo
• Optimized controller skins for every pose in both portrait and landscape
• Supports Split View multitasking with other apps
• Folding Duo puts DS games to sleep, just like closing the lid of a real DS

Sega Genesis
• Delta does what Nintendon’t!
• Sega Genesis games are now playable in Delta
• New controller skins for iPhone and iPad recreate the classic Genesis controller look
• Built-in support for Action Replay and GameGenie cheats

Liquid Glass UI
• Fresh new UI designed from the ground up for Liquid Glass
• Fully adapts to all screen sizes from Duo to iPad
• System icons mark every page in your Game Library
• Default artwork now has a light, glassy look

RetroAchievements
• Sign in with your RetroAchievements account to earn achievements in any supported game
• Supports Hardcore mode, which disables loading save states and using cheats
• Shows your achievement progress when you launch a game

Recents & Favorites
• New "Recently Played" and "Favorites" pages in Game Library
• Quickly jump back in to your most recently played games
• Add games to "Favorites" via long-press for easy access

Animated Controller Skins
• Controller skins come to life with support for fully animated buttons and controls
• Supports 3rd-party skins, so skin creators can make their own 
• Try Delta’s new official animated GBA skin, designed by Caroline Moore

Audio Settings
• New audio settings to control how Delta handles other apps’ audio
• "Mix with Other Audio" keeps music or podcasts playing alongside game audio
• "Pause Other Audio" pauses everything else when a game starts

Game Boy Color Palettes
• Customize how your Game Boy games look with color palettes for original Game Boy games
• Supports all the official color palettes from Game Boy Color

Custom Fast Forward Speeds
• Customize your experience with various Fast Forward speeds set per-game
• Adjust your game’s default speed at any time from the Pause Menu or in Game Settings

Adjustable Screen Position
• Long-press to move your game screen wherever you like when playing with a controller
• Easily move the screen above your favorite faceplate controllers

DLC
• Custom in-game experiences for classic Pokémon games
• Unlock event items, receive rare Pokémon, and more
• Supports all mainline GBA Pokémon games
• First DLC coming soon!

Redesigned Pause Menu
• Fully redesigned & animated pause menu with Liquid Glass
• Large, centered pause menu buttons make navigation simple
• Dynamically adjusts pause menu layout to scale to all window sizes
• Redesigned cheats screen with custom icons for additional customization

Redesigned Settings
• Reorganizes settings into more easily navigable hierarchy
• Displays icons for all top-level settings
• Redesigned controller input mapping screen for game controllers and keyboards
• New Lil’ Settings and Advanced sections for additional customizations

Custom Filters (Experimental Feature)
• Experience your games just how you remember with new custom game filters
• Set your filters per-system to change how games look across all your games
• Choose from a set list of defaults (e.g. CRT) or import your own custom filters from the Files app

Epilogue GB/SN Operator Support (Experimental Feature)
• Use your GB/SN Operator devices with Delta, thanks to the Epilogue team
• Connect game cartridges directly to your iPhone/iPad and play them natively 
• Reads and writes save files to cartridge
• GB and SN operators support GBC/GBA and SNES games respectively
• Blowing into cartridges optional

Misc.
• Added the ability to delete save states in bulk
• Fixed issue causing audio crackling for SNES games
• Fixed NES games occasionally opening to a black screen

apps.versionDescription:

apps.localizedDescription:
Delta is an all-in-one emulator for iOS and iPadOS. Delta builds upon the strengths of its predecessor, GBA4iOS, while expanding to include support for more game systems such as NES, SNES, N64, Nintendo DS, and Sega Genesis.

FEATURES

Supported Game Systems
• Nintendo Entertainment System
• Super Nintendo Entertainment System
• Nintendo 64
• Game Boy (Color)
• Game Boy Advance
• Nintendo DS
• Sega Genesis

Online Multiplayer
• Play online-compatible Nintendo DS games with friends around the world!
• Connect via community Nintendo WFC servers.
• Choose one of the default servers, or provide a custom DNS.

Controller Support
• Nintendo Switch Pro controllers, Joy-Cons
• Nintendo Switch Online controllers (NES, SNES, N64)
• PS4, PS5
• Xbox One S, Xbox Series X
• MFi game controllers
• Bluetooth & wired keyboards

RetroAchievements
• Sign in with your RetroAchievements account to earn achievements in any supported game.
• Supports Hardcore mode, which disables loading save states and using cheats.
• Shows your achievement progress when launching a game.

Save States
• Save and load save states for any game from the pause menu.
• Lock save states to prevent them from being accidentally overwritten.
• Automatically makes backup save states to ensure you never lose your progress.
• Support for “Quick Saves,” save states that can be quickly saved/loaded with a single button press (requires external controller).

Cheats
• Supports various types of cheat codes for each supported system:
• NES: Game Genie
• SNES: Game Genie, Pro Action Replay
• N64: GameShark
• GBC: Game Genie, GameShark
• GBA: Action Replay, Code Breaker, GameShark
• DS: Action Replay
• Genesis: Action Replay, Game Genie

Delta Sync
• Sync your games, game saves, save states, cheats, controller skins, and controller mappings between devices.
• View version histories of everything you sync and optionally restore them to earlier versions.
• Supports both Google Drive and Dropbox.

Custom Controller Skins
• Beautiful built-in controller skins for all systems.
• Import controller skins made by others, or even make your own to share with the world!
• Supports animated buttons for even more immersion when playing games.

Hold Button
• Choose buttons for Delta to hold down on your behalf, freeing up your thumbs to press other buttons instead.
• Perfect for games that typically require one button be held down constantly (ex: run button in Mario games, or the A button in Mario Kart).

Fast Forward
• Speed through slower parts of games by running the game much faster than normal.
• Easily enable or disable from the pause menu, or optionally with a mapped button on an external controller.
• Customize speed per-game by long-pressing Fast Forward option in pause menu.

3D/Haptic Touch
• Use 3D or Haptic Touch to “peek” at games, save states, and cheat codes.
• App icon shortcuts allow quick access to your most recently played games, or optionally customize the shortcuts to always include certain games.

Game Artwork
• Automatically displays appropriate box art for imported games.
• Change a game’s artwork to anything you want, or select from the built-in game artwork database.

Misc.
• Gyroscope support (WarioWare: Twisted! only)
• Microphone support (DS only)
• Support for delta:// URL scheme to jump directly into a specific game.

Delta Terms of Use: https://altstore.io/terms

**Delta is in no way affiliated with Nintendo or Sega. The name “Nintendo” and all associated game console names are registered trademarks of Nintendo Co., Ltd. The name “Sega” and all associated game console names are registered trademarks of Sega Corporation.**

iTorrent officially in the AltStore!

It is an ordinary torrent client for iOS with Files app support and much more.

What can this app do:

• Download in the background
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island progress bar
• Downloading on external drives
• Sequential download (use VLC to watch films while loading)
• Add torrent files from Share menu (Safari and other apps)
• Add magnet links directly from Safari
• Store files in Files app
• File sharing directly from app
• Download torrent by url
• Download torrent by magnet
• Show progress in Dynamic Island
• Send notification on torrent downloaded
• Web/WebDav Server
• Select files download priority
• Change UI to dark theme
• Color personalization
• RSS Feed
• ???

permissions.usageDescription: Needs to download torrents

apps.subtitle: Torrent client for iOS

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's new:
* Meet the new built-in VLC player. Play compatible video and audio files directly in iTorrent, even while they are still downloading.
* Enjoy Picture in Picture, playback speeds from 0.5x to 2x, audio and subtitle track selection, precise seeking, and system media controls.
* Take playback to a bigger screen with AirPlay or a compatible player discovered on your local network.
* Choose how pieces are downloaded with Sequential and First & Last priority modes, making it easier to start watching sooner.
* Select and share multiple completed files or entire folders in one go.

## Improvements:
* Refreshed the interface for iOS 26, with Liquid Glass styling, cleaner dialogs, and more polished navigation.
* Made torrent details smoother and easier to use, with clearer download-priority controls and private-torrent information.
* Improved media previewing so iTorrent can offer the best available player for each file.
* Updated the torrent and media engines for better compatibility, stability, and recovery from unexpected errors.
* Expanded and refined translations across all supported languages.

## Fixes:
* Fixed cases where magnet links could be saved incorrectly.
* Fixed a startup race condition that could interfere with launching the app or completing initial setup.
* Fixed toolbars and navigation behaving incorrectly in iPad split-screen mode.
* Fixed RSS downloads returning to the wrong screen.
* Fixed torrent details sometimes getting stuck in a continuous update loop.
* Fixed several playback, AirPlay, and local-device connection issues.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/XITRIX/iTorrent/compare/v2.1.1-1...v2.2.0-1

versions.localizedDescription:
What's New in 3.3.0

This is a big one. Four months of work since 3.2.1 covering iCloud sync, a completely revamped tvOS interface, video filters, and a ton of core and stability fixes.

☁️ iCloud / CloudKit Sync
- ROMs, save states, BIOS files, and artwork now sync across devices via iCloud
- Real-time download progress indicators when loading cloud save states
- Auto BIOS sync on game load when available in iCloud
- ROM metadata syncs alongside files
- Artwork syncs after library updates
- CloudKit records management tab in Settings
- iCloud upsell UI for new users with empty libraries
- Sync queue pauses during emulation and resumes after

📺 New tvOS UI (Default)
- Completely redesigned tvOS interface now enabled by default
- RetroWave-themed side menu with smooth animations
- Save states browser accessible from the main UI with artwork and core name
- "View All" saves section with per-system filtering
- TopShelf v2: recent games and save states with artwork and timestamps
- Cheats UI in the pause menu
- Game "More Info" panel
- Log viewer tab
- Import status view in side menu
- Search with persistent history
- Dozens of focus, navigation, and theming fixes throughout

🎨 Video Filters & Shaders
- Unified filter pipeline works across native and RetroArch cores
- GB and VHS filters improved
- Filters accessible from the pause menu
- RetroArch GLES 3D cores now supported (Vecx/GLiden, etc.)
- Dolphin shader/filter support
- PPSSPP filter support

🎮 Core & Controller Fixes
- **RetroArch**: Fixed player index mapping for MFi, PS4, and Xbox controllers; PS4 start/select fixed; 32x controls added; GameCube controller responder added
- **Mupen64Plus**: Fixed PS4 start button; fixed tvOS scaling and placement; better save error messages
- **Dolphin**: Fixed Vulkan landscape rendering
- **GenPluGX**: Added CHD support; added wide-screen GameGear core
- **PicoDrive**: Fixed crash on unload; fixed 32x controller mapping
- **FCEUmm**: Fixed start/select button mapping
- **Mednafen**: Fixed DualShock/DualSense pause/play button mapping
- **GameBatte / TGDB Dual**: Fixed PSX/Xbox pause/select button mapping

🐛 Bug Fixes & Stability
- Fixed multiple app hangs from main-thread Realm access (moved to background)
- Fixed crash in pause menu when closing core
- Fixed potential crash if audio ring buffer init fails
- Fixed crash in share/import extension
- Fixed aspect ratio issues in Stella and some other cores
- Fixed FPS label appearing in screenshots
- Fixed artwork not refreshing in game library after sync
- Fixed game importer re-queuing already-imported items
- Fixed Realm contentless core crash
- Fixed "Continue" carousel metadata mismatch
- Skin selector refreshes orientation previews on rotation change
- ManicSkin/DeltaSkin files can now be opened directly f

apps.localizedDescription:
Mindustry is a factory-building game with tower defense and RTS elements. Create elaborate supply chains to feed ammo into your turrets, produce materials to use for building, and construct units. Command units to capture enemy bases, and expand your production. Defend your core from waves of enemies.

Gameplay Features:

- Use production blocks to create a wide variety of advanced materials

- Defend your structures from waves of enemies

- Play with your friends in cross-platform multiplayer co-op games, or challenge them in team-based PvP matches

- Distribute liquids and fight constant challenges, like outbreaks of fire or enemy flier raids

- Get the most out of your production by supplying optional coolant and lubricant

- Produce a wide variety of units for automatic management of your base or assault on enemy bases

- Set up assembly lines to construct armies of mechanized units

- Use your units to square up against fully functional enemy bases


Campaign:

- Conquer the planets Serpulo and Erekir as you advance through 35 hand-made maps and 250+ procedurally generated sectors

- Capture territory and set up factories to produce resources while you play other sectors

- Defend your sectors from periodic invasions

- Coordinate resource distribution between sectors via launch pads

- Research new blocks to fuel progress

- Invite your friends to complete missions together

- 250+ technology blocks to master

- 50+ different types of drones, mechs and ships


Custom Games & Cross-Platform Multiplayer:

- 16+ built in maps for custom games, in addition to two entire campaigns

- Play co-op, PvP or sandbox

- Join a public dedicated server, or invite friends to your own private session

- Customizable game rules: Change block costs, enemy stats, starting items, wave timing and more

- Full functional map editor with scripting support

apps.localizedDescription:
Ferrite is a magnet search engine and debrid management app for iOS.

Compared to other platforms, iOS doesn't have any good options for using debrid services with media. Ferrite aims to change that by giving users a simple UI and an extensible framework to search the websites you want without all the clutter.

But, what is debrid? Well, it's a bunch of servers in the cloud that cache media from P2P sharing services. Therefore, a user does not have to worry about waiting for a P2P download to finish or waste storage space on one large file.

Ferrite also has other features for convenience including:
- Local library with history and bookmarks
- Cloud management
- Kodi integration
- Ad-free
- Flexible parser written in native Swift
- Intuitive filters while searching

These are the currently supported debrid services:
- RealDebrid
- AllDebrid
- Premiumize
- TorBox
- OffCloud

The app is free and 100% open sourced: https://github.com/Ferrite-iOS/ferrite

More information is in the app website: https://kingbri.dev/ferrite

Happy watching!

apps.localizedDescription:
Dive into an open world of building, crafting and survival. Gather resources, survive the night, and build whatever you can imagine one block at a time. Explore and craft your way through a completely open world where you can play with friends, build a city, start a farm, mine deep into the ground, face mysterious enemies, or just experiment to the limits of your imagination!

The possibilities are endless. Embark on an epic adventure and play with friends, building from the ground up. Build and expand in Creative mode, where you can craft from unlimited resources. Survive the night, face intense battles, craft tools, and fend off danger in Survival mode. With seamless cross-platform and multiplayer gameplay on Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, you can adventure solo or with friends, and discover an infinite, randomly generated world filled with blocks to mine, biomes to explore, and mobs to befriend (or battle)! 

 

In Minecraft, the world is yours to shape! 

 

CREATE YOUR WORLD 

• Build anything from the ground up 

• Craft from special resources and tools to create brand new structures and landscapes 

• Explore an endless open world full of different biomes and creatures 

• Minecraft Marketplace – Get creator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics on Minecraft Marketplace 

• Connect with millions of players on community servers, or subscribe to Realms Plus to cross-play with up to 10 friends on your own private server 

• Slash commands – Tweak how the game plays: you can change the weather, summon mobs, change the time of day, and more 

• Add-ons – Customize your experience even further with add-ons! If you're more tech-inclined, you can modify your game to create new resource packs 

 

MULTIPLAYER ONLINE GAMES 

• Join free massive multiplayer servers and play with thousands of others 

• Multiplayer servers allow you to play with up to 4 players online with a free Xbox Live account 

• Build, battle and explore other realms. With Realms and Realms Plus, you can play with up to 10 friends cross-platform, anytime, anywhere on Realms, your own private server that we host for you 

• With Realms Plus, get instant access to over 150 Marketplace items with new additions each month. Share with friends on your own private Realms server* 

• Connect and play with players across the world, wherever they are, and join in on MMO battles for survival in other worlds 

• Discover gigantic community-run worlds, compete in unique mini-games and socialize in lobbies full of fellow Minecrafters 

 

SUPPORT: https://www.minecraft.net/help 

LEARN MORE: https://www.minecraft.net/ 



Here are the links to our Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions:

To check the requirements for your device visit: https://help.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409172223501
